In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. showtimeshowcase.us.title: Piranha
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Gravity
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2013

showtimeextreme.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
showtimeextreme.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Saint

Musikalische Leitung: Jean-Christophe Spinosi - Inszenierung: Claus Guth. Mit Susan Gritton (Sopran), Bejun Mehta (Altus), Richard Croft (Tenor), Florian Boesch (Bass), Arnold-Schönberg-Chor, Ensemble Matheus. In seiner Inszenierung zeigt Claus Guth neue, zusätzliche Sichtweisen auf die Handlung um Jesus Christus und auf Fragen um Tod, Verlust, Trauer und Hoffnung. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-23
